This directory contains automatically generated extractive summaries.

Summary files are named <meeting-ID>-fulltrainresults.txt for historical
reasons, and consist of one record per line in the following format:

  <spurt-text><TAB><start-time><TAB><end-time><TAB><spurt-ID>

For example here, spurt EN2009d.A.spurt.2015 runs from 5098.53 seconds
into the meeting until 5099.95 seconds, and comprises the words "So that
all sounds good fun" (words within the spurt are space-separated):

  So that all sounds good fun	5098.53	5099.95	EN2009d.A.spurt.2015

Records are stored in descending order of importance, so the first spurt
is the most interesting and the last is the least interesting.  Many
have exactly the same score; these are stored in order of appearance,
but their parity is not captured by this format.
